card.name: Spelled-out numbers starting a sentence
card.fires_on: Spelled-out number words such as Forty, Thirty, Eleven or Sixty at the start of a sentence, and the hyphenated tail like -eight, just before the word percent in results text.

modes.label: Sentence-opening number word
modes.description: A number written in words begins a sentence about the share of patients.
modes.example: << Thirty>>-eight percent of respondents' leftover drugs had

modes.label: Second half of a compound number
modes.description: The ending part of a spelled-out number such as -eight, -four, -three or ty, right before percent.
modes.example: Eighty<<-three>> percent of infusion-related reactions occurred in C

card.writes: It pushes the model to write spelled-out tens and the word percent, and away from temperature or unit symbols.
card.plain: It marks a number written out in words at the start of a sentence, where the word percent is expected next.
